Vessel_Turnaround_Time = Time vessel spends at port (lower = better efficiency)

Operational_Cost_Reduction = Percentage decrease in total operating expenses
Average_Lock_Passage_Time = Hours required for vessel to pass through lock system
Annual_Throughput_Increase = Total additional tonnes that can be transported annually
Route_Optimization_Efficiency_Gain = Fuel and time saved through AI routing
Fuel_Consumption_Reduction = Percentage decrease in fuel usage per ton-km
Shipping_Cost_Reduction = Percentage decrease in per-unit shipping cost
Planning_Accuracy_Improvement = Percentage increase in predictive scheduling accuracy
Predictive_Maintenance_Accuracy = Percentage of equipment issues predicted before failure
Equipment_Failure_Reduction = Percentage decrease in breakdowns
Downtime_Reduction = Percentage decrease in out-of-service time
Safety_Incident_Prevention = Percentage reduction in accidents or safety violations
Processing_Time_Reduction = Time saved in document handling and customs
Administrative_Error_Reduction = Percentage decrease in documentation mistakes
Document_Cost_Savings = Percentage reduction in paperwork administrative costs
Operating_Cost_Reduction = Total percentage savings in vessel operation expenses
Total_Shipping_Cost_Reduction = Overall reduction including all logistics components
Door_to_Door_Delivery_Time = Total time from origin to final destination
Truck_Transport_Substitution = Percentage of cargo switched from road to water
Network_Coverage_Expansion = Additional kilometers of integrated transport network
